title: HPAclusteR
text: HPAclusteR R package designed Human Protein Atlas streamline process gene clustering transcriptomics data. provides modular pipeline performing PCA, calculating distances, constructing shared nearest neighbor (SNN) graphs, consensus clustering, UMAP, functional annotation, different publication-ready visualizations. package designed work AnnDatR objects, making easy integrate workflows transcriptomics data analysis.

text: begin, load HPAclusteR package: use built-example_adata dataset vignette. dataset toy example designed demonstrate functionality package. 💡 HPAclusteR can work AnnDatR objects created using AnnDatR package, long data transposed genes observations (rows) samples variables (columns). Alternatively, can use hc_initialize() function create properly formatted object directly data frames.
code: library(HPAclusteR)

title: HPAclusteR
text: 💡 part demonstrates step--step usage HPAclusteR pipeline. users prefer simplicity, hc_auto_cluster() function can used run entire pipeline one call.

title: HPAclusteR
text: PCA first step pipeline, used reduce dimensionality data retaining important features. PCA step reduces dimensionality data 40 components, can adjusted based dataset analysis goals. 💡 expression matrix contains missing values, hc_pca() reports many , default, imputes column mean fast SVD path used. Set na_action = "nipals" slower iterative algorithm handles missing values directly, na_action = "omit" drop affected genes.

title: HPAclusteR
text: Next, calculate pairwise distances samples using PCA-reduced data. hc_distance() function supports multiple distance metrics, “euclidean” “spearman”. use number components determined Kaiser’s rule.
code: adata_res <- hc_distance(   adata_res,   components = hc_kaisers_rule(adata_res),   method = "spearman" ) head(adata_res$uns$distance) #> [1] 1.0090909 1.3363636 0.3363636 0.6090909 1.3454545 1.2454545

what: Step 3: Shared Nearest Neighbor (SNN) Graph Construction

title: HPAclusteR 1.1.0
text: hc_pca() now stores PCA results list rather pcaMethods::pcaRes object. Use $scores, $loadings, $sdev, $r2cum, $method access results. hc_snn() longer similarity argument. distance metric determined hc_distance(). hc_auto_cluster() now uses snn_prune instead snn_similarity. UMAP embeddings may differ previous versions due switch umap-learn uwot. Results remain reproducible given seed. two implementations showed Spearman correlation 0.90 pairwise distances 0.77 overlap among 25-nearest neighbours, comparable variation uwot runs different seeds (~0.75). Community detection now uses igraph. Cluster labels counts may differ slightly previous versions. resulting clusterings showed Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) 0.96 previous implementation bundled example data, although individual cluster labels counts may differ slightly.

title: HPAclusteR 1.1.0
text: hc_pca() gains na_action handling missing values. default uses column-mean imputation; "nipals", "omit", "error" also available. hc_cluster_consensus() gains min_k max_k control accepted range cluster numbers. hc_umap() exposes min_dist spread parameters. hc_pca(), hc_kaisers_rule(), hc_auto_cluster() gain verbose argument. hpa_version now defaults NULL, using current Human Protein Atlas release. numeric version can still used select archived release.

title: HPAclusteR 1.1.0
text: Removed Python, Seurat, concaveman, associated system dependencies. pcaMethods now suggested dependency required hc_pca(na_action = "nipals"). Removed several unused dependencies, including factoextra, matrixStats, MASS, fpc, GGally, network, sna. Minimum R version now 4.2.0.

title: HPAclusteR 1.1.0
text: hc_cluster_consensus() can now rerun objects already contain clustering results. Fixed annotation alignment validation returning NULL instead FALSE. Fixed loss first TRRUST record reading annotation data. Fixed use hard-coded gene identifier columns hc_cluster_hulls() hc_umap(). Fixed degenerate polygons produced hc_cluster_hulls() small clusters. Fixed stale gene names serialising restoring objects. Fixed duplicated UMAP coordinates rerunning hc_umap(). Annotation database download failures now produce informative warnings. Fixed several joins relied implicit column matching. Fixed deprecated ggplot2 tidyselect usage.

title: HPAclusteR 1.1.0
text: PCA, consensus clustering, UMAP, cluster hulls, cluster stability substantially faster. Consensus clustering now reuses nearest-neighbour graph across runs. Annotation data loaded reused across annotation databases.

title: HPAclusteR 1.1.0
text: Annotation downloads now allow 30 minutes large files. annotation workflow handles unavailable optional Bioconductor packages without failing package examples vignette.
